acceptance_evidence.atomic_cutover: cutover_shadow requires allow_cutover=true, verifies shadow parity before os.replace, backs up an existing canonical DB with sqlite_online_backup, and leaves the legacy source DB in place.
acceptance_evidence.default_action: create_shadow performs online backup to .aiworkinghub/tasking/.task_queue.sqlite.shadow and parity verification only.
acceptance_evidence.online_backup: sqlite_online_backup uses sqlite3.Connection.backup into a private temp DB and atomically publishes the destination only after backup completion.
acceptance_evidence.parity: compare_parity covers schema fingerprint, counts for tasks/events/artifacts/callback_outbox/callback_batches, lifecycle-bearing task identities, and pending/inflight callback delivery identities.
acceptance_evidence.path_resolution: resolve_task_store_paths uses the AIWorkingHub repository manifest durable tasking directory; AITools.taskdb keeps BITNN_TASK_QUEUE_DB as the explicit compatibility override.
